[b]It Begins[/b]
Wes 19, July, 2028.
Around noon, outside the Horxciv Collex (Horizon Complex) in Wessernia.

A rented white pickup truck without a license plate pulls up to the main building of the complex, the Skile Crov (Sky Crown). Two minutes later a massive explosion is heard throughout the city as the front entrance of the Skile Crov is obliterated to pieces. Smoke fills the sky and sirens blare. Floors 1-5 are almost completely obliterated. There are scattered body parts here and there but for the most parts there is no sign of survivors from the 5 floor or lower. Many nearby are injured and debris has been launched up to a mile away. Multiple structures nearby were also damaged. The council of 13 was luckily unscathed for they were meeting with a group of college students who did a project on the Horxciv Collex. Unfortunately the staircase and elevators were both damaged in the explosion trapping almost 500 people who worked in the Skile Crov. In the end of the disaster 424 people were killed when the Skile Crov collapsed with over 350 people still trapped as well as many rescue workers trying to help save more people. Danny San made a speech stating that those responsible would have justice be served, but this was not the first, nor the last, in a recent outbreak of different anti-government groups starting in February after the list of new laws were put in place.

Here is the list of the 5 factions of rebels (excluding the government) that have started to fight against the government and its new laws:
[b]Rebel Factions[/b]

1. Freyn Tradion (Free Trade Union, FT for short). No official base but are commonly associated with the port city of Farie where most international products arrived as well as where many products were made. They are a large group of underground smugglers who only care about the economy because most of them were traders or merchants who were impacted by the new laws. The could care less about politics but since it seems like other factions won't give them what they want their fighting for their economic freedom. They mainly rely on imports of weapons as well as looting to fight but they also use the black market, smuggling, and bribery to beat back the government and resist the laws forced upon them.

2. InronVael (Iron Viel, IV for short). Stationed in the city of Gareth surrounded by large mountains and thick forests, these anarchists believe that there should be no government at all and instead the nation as a people should participate in the community. They are responsible for the deadly Horxciv Collex as well as many other attacks but are very unstructured thus making it hard to rally against a cause. That plus the amount of munition they have makes them a loose cannon that is unpredictable. They use terrorism, guerrilla warfare, and sabotage to win.

3. Silen Baner Mova (Silent Banner Movement, SBM for short). They are by far the weakest faction but also the most realistic. They hope to return freedom to the people while also limiting the government's (specifically the Head Council's) power. They are mostly educated people who believe in peaceful protests and silent resistance as well as underground organization to win. They also want to remove private industry because they believe it is corrupt and will lead to either anarchy or a nation controlled by private companies. They are officially stationed in the Karnen City but have very little control overall because the are being attacked by all factions, sometimes other factions attack SBM at the same time.

4. Valmornian Qarth (Valmornian Party, VQ for short). They believe that Western View should go back to the authoritarian dictatorship days of Vamorniany where there was one religion and one unified people. They also want Western View to take back Kolionia seeing as it's currently in the hands of Neue Republik, a member of the EDU. They use propaganda, espionage, and military tactics to win. They are loosely allied with Guhui'Bernardio (see below) and are based in the city of Valmornia which is the capital of the Valmorny religion.

5. Guhui'Bernardio (GB, no actual translation to English but many say that it means "Keepers of Zatugi and the Religion of Valmorny). They think that Western View should be controlled by the most renowned Vamornian religious figures in the nation. They use terrorism, assassinations, and other torture to win. They are stationed in Ostren Kaloe, a small city outside of Valmornia. What makes it hard for VQ and GB to be allied is there different political views.

[b]The situation in Wessernian[/b]
Wessernian is the main battling grounds for the factions and government. Each faction has their own territory in Wessernia with the government in the middle at the Horxciv Collex. Where these territories meet are what are known as "athes ozin" ("ash zones") or collectively as no man's land's. Many citizens in the areas have left or gone into hiding. there are so many ruins which is why they call it ash zones.

[b]International Cries[/b]
The many factions and Wessern government have all asked nations to help them out, what matters is who they choose and how they choose to fight.

[spoiler=[b]Confidential[/b]][b][pre]Plenary meeting, 11 a.m.

Military Directorate Minutes

CONFIDENTIAL[/pre][/b]

[u]His Serene Highness[/u] the Prince of Sallach, extending a warm welcome to the Montfleurois and Vespurian Military Staff and the Minhokaean delegation, said that this meeting was of utmost consequence to the peace and stability of Elseyr. He suggested that the Comte de Porcéan undertake an immediate survey of the Wessernian situation and to illuminate to the Council of Sovereigns the most apparent course of action to be undertaken for the good of all.

[u]Comte de Porcéan[/u], responding to that recommendation, outlined that the Other Ministry was already endeavoring both by air and by sea to understand the immediate situation. The Palatine Guards in particular informed His Serene Highness that the Valmornian Party may be of intriguing consequence to ONE interests.

[u]His Serene Highness[/u] asked in what manner and purpose the Valmornians had piqued his interest.

[u]Comte de Porcéan[/u] indicated that, in addition to aligning closely with the values of the New Erene, the Valmornians hold unfavorable and strongly irredentist views against the Hochdeutsch, namely the loss of critical territory in the north of Elseyr which it seeks to recover as a matter of government policy. The Comte went on to state that it is ready and waiting for approval to consider intervention on behalf of that faction especially in light of the recent and successful stabilization of the former Rosenmarkket regions, which have since been returned to Montfleurois control.

[u]Comte d'Ardalay[/u] then explained the natural difficulties which ONE is expected to contend, namely the limited geography and isolation of the country from the rest of Elseyr. Furthermore, the Montfleurois state is unable and unwilling to commit to such a massive military operation so soon after unification, and the ministry of the Chief Consul De Lorraine has similarly expressed her disapproval at the timing of these plans, though understanding their immense geopolitical value.

[u]General de Funes[/u], speaking on behalf of the Montfleurois staff, similarly confirmed De Lorraine's reservations, but nevertheless argued for some manner of ONE intervention to secure the interests of the organization. He stated that the Gendarmes have not yet been deactivated for security reasons and are ready for deployment anywhere in the continent together with the Corps des Maréchaussée in Belgarde. He stresses, however, that logistical difficulties in this operation may demand total consideration of the use of THEP assets by the Montfleurois state, in particular its integrated bases arrangement that shall permit ONE forces to station at the Western Straits as a forward operating base.

[u]Field Marshal Haigh[/u] explains that the Vespurian Armed Forces, presuming all goes well, shall be able to field the 4th Sacros Infantry Corps together with a carrier strike group should ONE intervention escalate to such an extent that shall require the fullest armaments available to ONE.

[u]Comte d'Ardalay[/u], together with Comte de Porcéan, advised against heavy-handed interventions for now, but agree that some manner of heavy equipment is necessary to ensure that the civil war predictably proceeds in a direction that is ideal to ONE. For now, it was hoped that the operation shall be constituted by a multinational force of 2 frigates, 4 avisos, and 1 replenishment oiler to deliver humanitarian and logistical aid to the Valmornian Party.

[u]Field Marshal Haigh[/u] said in accordance with the view he had expressed at Valcoeur that the success of any military operations on Elseyr shall require the successful coordination of land operations, of which he remains distrustful of this organization's present capabilities.

[u]Comte de Porcéan[/u] said that the naval operations in the Wessernian coast would not necessarily coordinated with and linked to a land campaign, and that ONE naval superiority in this area should only ensure the security of communications and remain an ever-present threat to the enemy. It should be remembered that the main fleet base, even should ONE be deprived access to THEP bases, will still be several thousand kilometers away from the area in which land forces are expected to be operating. Thus, there can be no comparison between these operations and those that had been previously carried out in the former Rosenmarkket islands.

In conclusion, the plenary meeting agreed that ONE intervention in the Wessernian Civil War would be necessary, but not to the scale initially considered expedient by the Sallacher military staff.[/spoiler]

- - -

[b]ONE Intervention in the Wessernian Civil War[/b]

Following an emergency session of the Military Directorate of the Order of the New Erene, it was swiftly decided that prompt action will be necessary to rapidly stabilize the Wessernian state. With its government having failed to uphold its social contract to the nation, the ONE leadership agreed that the most expedient measure at the present time shall be to support the cause of the Valmornian Party, who presently run some sections of the country together with the Guhui'Bernardio.

It was agreed that a flotilla of seven warships, all provided by the Sallacher Naval Equipage, shall be first made available to support the Valmornians in their endeavors, to be constitued by the following ships:

[list][b]Intervention Flotilla[/b]

[u]1. Cover Group[/u] (CF. L'Age de Joyeuse)

[i]Argus[/i], frigate
[i]Galathée[/i], frigate

[u]2. Screen Group[/u] (CC. de Caussade)

[i]Changeant[/i], aviso
[i]Engageant[/i], aviso
[i]Gracieuse[/i], aviso
[i]Inconnu[/i], aviso

[u]3. Support Group[/u] (CC. Brancas)

[i]Observateur[/i], replenishment oiler[/list]

Along with their full complements, the force shall carry with it three Sallacher infantry companies drawn from elements of the Sallacher Corps des Carabiniers and Palatine Guards totaling to around 311 men. For now, the duty of this force shall be limited to escort missions for future support to the Valmornians, non-combatant evacuation operations, and special operations raids as required by their military leadership.
